title: exotic xerem portuguese cod bisque
description: a light, comforting bisque featuring cod, red chilli, and the subtle flavors of mushi-mono steam.
instructions: heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for a further 1-2 minutes.
add the sliced shallots and red chilli, and cook until they begin to soften.
add the cod fillets and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they begin to flake.
add the white wine and fish stock, and bring to a simmer.
reduce the heat to low and let the mixture steam for 10-15 minutes, using the mushi-mono to trap the heat.
remove the cod from the saucepan and set aside.
use an immersion blender to puree the remaining mixture until smooth.
return the cod to the saucepan and stir to combine.
season the bisque with lemon juice to taste, then serve immediately.
